d: Long, straight orange-copper hair is styled with long side-swept bangs and two high pigtails tied with ribbons. Large, wide-set sky-blue eyes have a neutral expression on a youthful, teenage face. The build is slender, dressed in a white short-sleeved sailor-style blouse with a grey collar, black buttons, and a pleated sage-green skirt. Heavy grey metallic ship rigging with cannons is attached to the back and arms.
